text:
maya: Customer NimbleCart (prod account nimble-42) opened ticket; they report price_lookup plugin calls stopped after our 2026-03-14 rollout. Assistant replies without calling the plugin even when prompt expects it. They gave two request_ids: req_abc123 (worked 2026-03-13) and req_def456 (failing 2026-03-15).

kevin: can you paste the failing API payload and which model/routing they hit?

maya: here's the failing payload:
```json
{"input":"Find price for SKU 9783","model":"redwood-core-1.2","tools":[{"name":"price_lookup","params":{"sku":"9783"}}],"request_id":"req_def456"}
```

ramon: I'm seeing a ton of router warnings in runtime logs around rollout-20260314. Sample: ```WARN tool_router: no compatible tool for call price_lookup - policy=prefer_name=false``` Also a few 422s from the router.

sara: note we changed tool-router default in that deploy to prefer schema/param matching over explicit name matching (call_by_name=false) — intent was to reduce misfires for ambiguous prompts, but it can break older prompts that rely on name-only calls.

julian: can we rollback that flag for the Dedicated pool serving nimble-cart? Where's the config?

maya: customer SLA 24h, escalating. Ticket: https://support.redwood/in/12345

ops-oncall: queued rollback on canary and started limited rollback to region us-east-1. rollout id rollout-20260314-r1. ETA for visible impact ~30m.

kevin: for repro we need the full assistant output + router debug for req_def456. maya, please forward the full payload + response.

maya: forwarded. customer also observed a mis-mapped arg: router sent {"productId":"9783"} instead of expected {"sku":"9783"} in one response — looks like a param-normalizer mapping regression.

sara: param-normalizer change landed in that deploy. I'll prepare a patch to fallback to name-based binding if schema matching fails and open a PR; won't merge until ops approves.

julian: assign eng-runtime and eng-ml to this thread and add a regression test to the eval suite to catch name-only calls.

support-bot: Ticket #12345 updated: priority=high, assignees=[maya, sara], status=escalated.

ramon: customer provided a minimal repro curl to reproduce locally:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-core-1.2","input":"Find price for SKU 9783","tools":[{"name":"price_lookup","params":{"sku":"9783"}}],"request_id":"req_def456"}'
```

maya: thanks — I'll keep customer updated. post rollback status here.

ops-oncall: rollback complete on canary (00:28 UTC). sampled requests show plugin calls returning. continuing mitigation and monitoring.
